# American Heart Association

> The American Heart Association helps people prevent and treat heart disease and stroke through education, research, advocacy, CPR training, and community programs.

The American Heart Association (AHA) is a nonprofit organization focused on longer, healthier lives. Its website includes public health education, condition-specific information, healthy living guidance, emergency response and CPR resources, professional education, research and advocacy content, and ways to give, volunteer, and participate in local events.

## Core Information
- [American Heart Association Home](https://www.heart.org/): Main entry point for AHA programs, health education, advocacy, and ways to get involved.
- [About Us](https://www.heart.org/en/about-us): Overview of the organization, mission, leadership, and impact.
- [Heart Attack and Stroke Symptoms](https://www.heart.org/en/about-us/heart-attack-and-stroke-symptoms): Signs of heart attack, stroke, and cardiac arrest, including emergency response guidance.
- [Volunteer](https://www.heart.org/en/volunteer): Volunteer opportunities supporting events, advocacy, education, and community outreach.
- [Get Involved](https://www.heart.org/en/get-involved): Central hub for volunteering, fundraising, advocacy, and local participation.
- [Ways to Give](https://www.heart.org/en/get-involved/ways-to-give): Donation options including individual, workplace, planned, and memorial giving.

## Health Topics and Conditions
- [Health Topics](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics): Directory of cardiovascular and stroke conditions, risk factors, and treatments.
- [Heart Attack](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/heart-attack): Causes, symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, and recovery information for heart attack.
- [Stroke](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/stroke): Stroke warning signs, prevention, treatment, and recovery resources.
- [High Blood Pressure](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/high-blood-pressure): Information on hypertension risks, monitoring, treatment, and lifestyle changes.
- [Cholesterol](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/cholesterol): Guidance on cholesterol numbers, risks, and management.
- [Heart Failure](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/heart-failure): Education on symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, and living with heart failure.
- [Atrial Fibrillation](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/atrial-fibrillation): Overview of AFib symptoms, stroke risk, and treatment options.
- [Cardiac Arrest](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/cardiac-arrest): Information on sudden cardiac arrest, response, and survival.

## Healthy Living
- [Healthy Living](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living): Main hub for prevention, wellness, and everyday heart-healthy habits.
- [Healthy Lifestyle](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle): Practical guidance on habits that support cardiovascular health.
- [Life's Essential 8](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/lifes-essential-8): AHA framework for measuring and improving cardiovascular health.
- [Healthy Eating](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating): Nutrition guidance, meal planning, and heart-healthy food choices.
- [Physical Activity](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/fitness): Exercise recommendations and activity tips for heart health.
- [Quit Smoking Tobacco and Vaping](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/quit-smoking-tobacco): Resources for quitting smoking, vaping, and tobacco use.
- [Sleep](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/sleep): Sleep health information and its connection to cardiovascular wellness.
- [Stress Management](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/stress-management): Strategies for reducing stress and supporting overall health.

## Nutrition and Recipes
- [Healthy Food Facts](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/healthy-food-facts): Explanations of fats, sodium, sugar, fiber, and other nutrition topics.
- [Eat Smart](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/eat-smart): Tips for shopping, cooking, and making healthier food choices.
- [Nutrition Basics](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/nutrition-basics): Foundational nutrition guidance for heart-healthy eating patterns.
- [Recipes](https://recipes.heart.org/en): Searchable collection of heart-healthy recipes and meal ideas.
- [Heart-Check Foods](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/heart-check-foods): Information about the Heart-Check certification program for qualifying foods.
- [Healthy for Good](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/healthy-for-good): Consumer campaign focused on lasting healthy behavior change.

## CPR, First Aid, and Emergency Cardiovascular Care
- [CPR & First Aid](https://cpr.heart.org/en): AHA training portal for CPR, first aid, and emergency cardiovascular care.
- [Find a Course](https://cpr.heart.org/en/courses): Browse CPR, AED, first aid, and advanced life support courses.
- [Hands-Only CPR](https://cpr.heart.org/en/resources/hands-only-cpr): Learn the basics of Hands-Only CPR for bystander response.
- [CPR Facts and Stats](https://cpr.heart.org/en/resources/cpr-facts-and-stats): Data and educational material about cardiac arrest and CPR outcomes.
- [Basic Life Support (BLS)](https://cpr.heart.org/en/courses/basic-life-support-course-options): Course options for healthcare professionals needing BLS training.
- [Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS)](https://cpr.heart.org/en/courses/advanced-cardiovascular-life-support-course-options): Advanced resuscitation training for clinical teams.
- [Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS)](https://cpr.heart.org/en/courses/pediatric-advanced-life-support-course-options): Pediatric emergency care training for healthcare providers.
- [Heartsaver First Aid CPR AED](https://cpr.heart.org/en/courses/heartsaver-first-aid-cpr-aed-course-options): Workplace and community training in first aid, CPR, and AED use.

## Patients, Families, and Support
- [Support Network](https://supportnetwork.heart.org/): Online communities for people affected by heart disease and stroke.
- [Caregiver Support](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/caregiver-support): Resources for caregivers supporting loved ones with cardiovascular conditions.
- [Stroke Family Warmline](https://www.stroke.org/en/help-and-support/stroke-family-warmline): Support and information for stroke survivors and families.
- [Tools and Resources](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/consumer-healthcare/what-is-cardiovascular-disease/tools-and-resources): Consumer-oriented tools for understanding cardiovascular disease and care.
- [Warning Signs and Symptoms of a Stroke](https://www.stroke.org/en/about-stroke/stroke-symptoms): Stroke symptom recognition and emergency action guidance.
- [Life After Stroke](https://www.stroke.org/en/life-after-stroke): Recovery, rehabilitation, and long-term support after stroke.

## Professionals and Scientific Resources
- [For Professionals](https://professional.heart.org/en): Professional portal for clinicians, researchers, and healthcare teams.
- [Professional Heart Daily](https://professional.heart.org/en/science-news): Scientific news, guideline updates, and professional education content.
- [Guidelines and Statements](https://professional.heart.org/en/guidelines-and-statements): Clinical practice guidelines, scientific statements, and advisories.
- [Journals](https://professional.heart.org/en/journals): Access points for AHA scientific journals and publications.
- [Continuing Education](https://professional.heart.org/en/education): Professional education and continuing learning opportunities.
- [Research Programs](https://professional.heart.org/en/research-programs): Funding, awards, and research support information.
- [Quality Improvement](https://professional.heart.org/en/quality-improvement): Hospital and health system programs to improve cardiovascular and stroke care.

## Advocacy, Research, and News
- [Advocacy](https://www.heart.org/en/get-involved/advocate): Public policy and grassroots advocacy for heart and brain health.
- [News](https://newsroom.heart.org/): Press releases, announcements, and media resources from AHA.
- [The Heart Truth and Research Updates](https://www.heart.org/en/news): Consumer-facing news and health updates from AHA.
- [Research](https://www.heart.org/en/about-us/research-programs): Overview of AHA-funded research and scientific impact.
- [Go Red for Women](https://www.goredforwomen.org/en): Campaign focused on women’s cardiovascular health awareness and prevention.
- [Stroke.org](https://www.stroke.org/en): AHA stroke-focused education, recovery, and support resources.

## Get Involved, Donate, and Shop
- [Donate Now](https://www.heart.org/en/get-involved/ways-to-give): Donation pathways supporting AHA programs, research, and education.
- [Fundraise](https://www.heart.org/en/get-involved/ways-to-give/fundraise): Personal and community fundraising opportunities for AHA causes.
- [Volunteer Opportunities](https://www.heart.org/en/volunteer): Ways to volunteer locally and nationally with AHA programs.
- [Find Your Local AHA](https://www.heart.org/en/affiliates): Local offices, events, and community resources by region.
- [ShopHeart](https://www.shopheart.org/): Official AHA store for branded items, educational materials, and gifts.
- [Heart Walk](https://www.heartwalk.org/): Community fundraising walks supporting heart health and research.
- [Go Red for Women Events](https://www.goredforwomen.org/en/get-involved): Events, campaigns, and participation opportunities supporting women’s heart health.
